jq.name: the scenario holds a read-only ceiling named by GENTS_LSP_WORKSPACE
the scenario expects lsp hover calls with their results
jq.expr: .scenario.expect.tool_calls as $calls | ($calls | any(.tool_name == "lsp" and .action == "hover")) and ($calls | any(.result_contains | index("FileToolMode") != null)) and ([["crates/gents-loop/src/tool_policy.rs", "meet", "Disabled"], ["crates/gents/src/toolset/lsp/auth.rs", "lsp_advertised", "FileToolMode"]] | all(. as [$file, $symbol, $needle] | $calls | any(.tool_name == "lsp" and .action == "hover" and .file == $file and .symbol == $symbol and (.result_contains | index($needle) != null))))
